# semaphore_ex_global_notification_delivery_retry (Action)

Retries an existing notification delivery explicitly. The server checks current destination revision and claim state. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_global_notification_delivery_retry" "example" {
  config {
    delivery_id = 2
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_global_notification_delivery_retry.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `delivery_id` (Number)
